jay_support: FYI, we just got a priority-1 from AcmeCorp — huge p99 latency spike on their production model after yesterday's quantization profile update. Their SLA is 200ms and p99 is now ~1.8s :grimacing:

maria_custsuccess: Ugh, they reported errors + timeouts. Any quick mitigations?

sam_oncall: Can we roll them back to fp16 or disable int8 for that customer?

jay_support: They are on model: gptx-large-v2 with custom quant profile int8+fp8 fallback. Started at ~04:12 UTC after the calibration job ran. Attached logs they pasted: `ERROR: model served slow` and p95=420ms p99=1830ms

ana_runtime: tagging @ana_runtime — can you confirm whether the calibration job changed memory placement or kernel selection?

ana_runtime: @ana_runtime sorry typo — meant to tag you.

ana_runtime: (bot) deploy-bot: rollback plan available: disable-quant-profile v2024-11-10

ana_runtime: Looking at telemetry, the calibration resulted in FP8 falling back to slower kernel on this GPU due to alignment mismatch on sequence lengths. We also see increased jitter in KV cache reuse.

li_ml: Repro steps requested from AcmeCorp? Ask for curl call and payload sizes. Also check whether they were using prefix caching or dynamic batching.

jay_support: I asked for repro and they sent a minimal curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"gptx-large-v2","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":256}'` They said p99 only spikes on requests with 1-2 token inputs interleaved with long contexts.

ana_runtime: That pattern (short inference after long context) can break batching heuristics and force small-batch kernel paths. With int8 quant and the new profile, kernel chosen is high-overhead for small seq.

ana_runtime: Immediate mitigation options:
- disable int8 quant for that tenant (force fp16)
- pin model to previous quant profile (rollback)
- temporary route traffic to dedicated pool with older kernel image

sam_oncall: Can we do a hotfix: set per-tenant override to prefer fp16 for that model ID? That would be fastest.

ana_runtime: Yes. I can push a per-tenant override. Need tenant id and confirm we can do it without restarting.

jay_support: Tenant id: acme-447. They gave permission for emergency changes. Please do it and monitor p95/p99.

li_ml: Also request they send a small repro script that hits with the same mixing pattern. I'll run an instrumented trace to see whether KV cache thrash or a kernel fallback path is to blame.

maria_custsuccess: I'm on the call scheduled in 10 mins with Acme to acknowledge and share mitigation ETA.

ana_runtime: Actioned per-tenant override to prefer fp16 for acme-447 at 2410554620. Rolling config out to edge nodes.

sre-bot: (bot) config-change: applied per-tenant model_quant_override acme-447 -> fp16 by ana_runtime at 2410554620

sam_oncall: Checking metrics now... p99 dropped to ~380ms within 90s. p95 ~210ms. :thumbsup:

jay_support: Great — please keep monitoring for 30m and then we can talk about long-term fix.

li_ml: I'll run calibration repro locally and try tweaking alignment/pack settings for int8 kernels. If we can make kernel selection consistent for small-batch cases, we can re-enable int8 safely.

ana_runtime: Long-term follow-ups:
- add a pre-flight heuristic to avoid the new kernel for requests where seq mix indicates small-batch paths
- enhance quant calibration to prefer kernels that maintain low tail latency for mixed lengths
- add a per-tenant canary gate around quant-profile rollouts

maria_custsuccess: I updated the ticket: mitigation applied, customer notified, next update in 1h.

jay_support: Thanks all. li_ml pls post repro run results here when ready. I'll keep this thread pinned to the incident.

li_ml: Will do. Preliminary note: fp8 fallback path had a 3x p99 penalty on our test GPU for 1-token pops.

sam_oncall: Creating follow-up engineering issue: ENG-RUNTIME-7291 "int8/fp8 quant kernel selection causes p99 regressions for mixed-length workloads" and linking to this thread.

jay_support: Closing loop: customer confirmed perf improvement. Leaving open until li_ml posts root cause.

li_ml: Root cause note forthcoming — early hypothesis: calibration chose FP8 microkernels that require per-request re-allocation when KV cache is reused across variable-length sequences.

maria_custsuccess: :pray: nice work everyone.
